answer.text: Price changes are largely random — past prices don't predict future

explanation.text: The Logic: Random walk: price changes uncorrelated across time. Weak-form efficient markets exhibit random walk. The Trap: 'Predictable' is opposite of random walk. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational. Manager's Pro-Tip: Exceptions (momentum, mean-reversion over certain horizons) are documented but small — not exploitable after fees.
